title: Quest Foglight for Databases getSource XML External Entity Processing Information Disclosure… (CVE-2026-92198)
description: CVE-2026-92198 is an XML External Entity (XXE) vulnerability in the getSource method of Quest Foglight for Databases. It allows remote attackers to cause the XML parser to access arbitrary URIs and disclose information without authentication. This can lead to sensitive data exposure in the context of the application.
